C0898.title: Beijing Police Dismantle 5 Hospital Appointment-Scalping Software Rings in 'Clean Net 2021' Operation
C0898.summary: In 2021, Beijing police, as part of the 'Clean Net 2021' campaign, took down five criminal groups using appointment-scalping software to illegally seize and resell hospital slots, arresting 66 individuals including developers, users, and scalpers. The software employed automated methods to mass-harvest medical appointments, representing a typical cybercrime operation involving bulk account scannin
